content: The autonomous-task-brain skill defines a reusable closed-loop autonomous task management workflow with 5 standardized stages: 1) Perceive: scan recent sessions to identify new/repeating tasks and failure patterns; 2) Retrieve: search local skills, historical sessions, memory engines, and GitHub for optimal solutions; 3) Decide: select handling action (execute/suggest/skip) based on historical success rate, task complexity, and user preferences; 4) Execute: auto-create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts or delegate subtasks; 5) Review: record execution results and update the knowledge base for future optimization.
